part.text:
All 40 tests pass (31 existing + 9 new), and the build compiles cleanly. Summary of what was added:

- **Types**: `Page.template` and `BuildOptions.templatesDir` (src/types.ts), frontmatter `template` field parsed in src/parser.ts.
- **`src/templateEngine.ts`**: new `TemplateEngine` class wrapping an isolated Handlebars instance — loads `templates/layouts/*.hbs` and `templates/partials/*.hbs`, selects a page's layout by its frontmatter `template` (falling back to `default`), renders `{{{body}}}` from the page's markdown HTML, and registers empty `header`/`nav`/`footer` partials by default so layouts referencing them never break.
- **`src/templates.ts`**: refactored (byte-identical output) to expose `renderArticleBody`/`renderIndexBody`, reused by both the legacy renderer and the new template engine.
- **`src/generator.ts`**: `buildSite` now uses `TemplateEngine` when `templatesDir` is given and exists, falling back to the original hardcoded renderer per-page/index when a layout is missing — so calling `buildSite` without `templatesDir` (as existing tests/consumers do) is unaffected.
- **`src/cli.ts`**: new `--templates <dir>` option, defaulting to `./templates`.
- **`./templates/`**: real default files — `layouts/default.hbs`, `layouts/index.hbs`, `layouts/post.hbs` (example alternate template), and `partials/header.hbs`, `nav.hbs`, `footer.hbs`.
- Added `handlebars` as a direct dependency and regenerated `package-lock.json`.
- New/updated tests across templateEngine, generator, parser, templates, and cli test files covering layout selection, partials, fallback behavior, and the `--templates` CLI flag.
